details:
Q1: Which part of the repository should this issue change?
Choices:
A) A specific workflow or pipeline phase (clarify, plan, implement, review/autofix, orchestrate, validate, heal); name it in the answer (RECOMMENDED)
B) Documentation (README.md, docs/, agents.d/ fragments)
C) A specific script or helper under scripts/; name the file in the answer
D) Something else; describe it in the answer
Q2: What does "better" mean for that target?
Choices:
A) Fix a specific bug or failure; link the failing run, issue or PR in the answer (RECOMMENDED)
B) Add a specific new behaviour or feature; describe the expected behaviour in the answer
C) Improve performance or cost (runtime, API calls, tokens); state the metric and target in the answer
D) Improve clarity or maintainability with no change in behaviour; describe the scope in the answer
Q3: How will we know the change is done?
Choices:
A) A concrete acceptance check, such as a test, a log line or an observable outcome, stated in the answer (RECOMMENDED)
B) Reviewer judgement only (note: this usually leads to another round of clarification at planning)
